cta_caption: Comment REPLIES aur main full guide DM kar dunga 📩

slides.headline: PUBLIC REPLY + [DM]
slides.label: SHORT ANSWER
lines: Har matching comment pe **public reply**, aur chaho toh **DM** bhi.

slides.headline: [2–3] REPLIES ROTATE
slides.label: STAY NATURAL
lines: 2–3 alag replies, **random** pick, **@username** ke saath. Spam nahi lagta.

slides.headline: PUBLIC [KYUN]?
slides.label: WHY
lines: Log dekhte hain commenting **kaam karta** hai, toh aur comments, reel aur **reach**.

slides.headline: LINK [MAT] DAALO
slides.label: STAY SAFE
lines: Public reply mein **link nahi**. Variations use karo jaise **{Sent|Done}**.

slides.headline: SIRF [DM]?
slides.label: FAQ
lines: Haan, automation mein **public replies off** kar do.
